description: Renovate settings shared by Clayton's repositories. Updates open on Monday mornings for manual review once a release is 14 days old; digest updates and pre-commit hook updates arrive on Thursday mornings. Both windows run from midnight through 11:59 AM Eastern, wide enough to catch at least one of Mend's best-effort runs, which start every few hours with no fixed time.

packageRules.description: Hold npm version updates for the same 14 days. config:best-practices sets 3 days for npm in a package rule, which would otherwise take precedence over the top-level wait.
Auto-merge pre-commit hook updates if CI passes
Auto-merge GitHub Actions digest updates if CI passes. Limited to actions and reusable workflows: the manager also finds workflow container and service images, which the Docker digest rule covers.
Offer Docker digest updates on Thursdays without waiting. Whether one merges automatically is up to each repository, which knows which of its files CI tests or deploys.
Do not pin the reusable Renovate evaluation workflow; it intentionally tracks main
